job: Hold a titled group of content, or a 320px pane of sessions beside the rail.
purpose: A bordered box with a head and a body, used as the side panel of a split. With data-variant="pane" it becomes a 320px pane between the rail and the content, with its own 64px head aligned to the top bar and a scrolling body. The pane hides below 900px.
useWhen: Details sit beside the thing they describe and need a head.
A screen is built around a list of sessions or items in its own column.

avoidWhen.when: The content is an object in a grid or list.
A temporary surface that opens over the page.
Settings for one group inside a form.

variants.useWhen: A fixed 320px column next to the rail that holds a list, such as sessions.
